name: W Aspen
insider_take: Where avant-garde luxury meets Rocky Mountain grandeur in the heart of America's most exclusive ski town.
whats_special: The W Aspen sits at 7,908 feet elevation, making it one of the highest luxury hotels in North America. This bold property transforms traditional Alpine charm with contemporary design, featuring a stunning living room lobby with a two-story stone fireplace and floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing the dramatic Aspen Mountain backdrop. The hotel's signature WET Deck offers the rare experience of outdoor hot tubs with panoramic views of four 14,000-foot peaks.
pro_tip: Book during "mud season" (April-May or October-November) for significantly lower rates while still enjoying world-class spa treatments and the hotel's heated outdoor spaces with those same incredible mountain views.
dont_miss: The hotel's underground tunnel system connects directly to the Silver Queen Gondola, allowing ski-in/ski-out access without stepping outside. After hitting the slopes, unwind at the rooftop WET Deck's infinity hot tub while watching the alpenglow illuminate the Maroon Bells - a sight that's particularly magical during the golden hour just before sunset.
pros: Prime ski-in/ski-out location on Aspen Mountain
Vibrant après-ski scene and nightlife atmosphere
Modern luxury amenities with W Hotels' signature style
cons: Premium pricing typical of luxury Aspen properties
Lively party atmosphere may not suit all travelers
